name: Sky10 Channels
description: Connect OpenClaw agents to sky10 and sky10-backed messaging channels

agentName.description: Name to register as on the sky10 network

skills.description: Skills to advertise on the sky10 network

gatewayToken.description: Gateway API bearer token (if auth is enabled)

messagingWsUrl.description: Optional sky10 messenger bridge websocket URL

connectionId.description: Optional Telegram connection ID to bind this account to

pollIntervalMs.description: Telegram bridge polling interval in milliseconds

replayOnStart.description: Replay existing Telegram events when the gateway starts
